successCriteria.description: The three shared enums — LeaveType (annual|sick|emergency|unpaid|maternity|paternity), LeaveStatus (DRAFT|SUBMITTED|APPROVED|REJECTED|CANCELLED), and AuditAction (CREATE|SUBMIT|UPDATE|DELETE|APPROVE|REJECT|CANCEL) — are defined as TypeScript enums and exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` with exactly those member names and string values.

The `Employee` entity interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `fullName: string`, `email: string`, `department: string`, `managerId: string | null`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`.

The `IEmployeeRepository` interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/employee/employee.repository.interface.ts` with methods `findById(id: string): Promise<Employee | null>`, `findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>`, and `findByDepartment(department: string): Promise<Employee[]>`, importing `Employee` from `./employee.model`.

The `IEmployeeService` interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/employee/employee.service.interface.ts` with methods `getEmployeeById(id: string): Promise<Employee | null>` and `getEmployeeByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>`, importing `Employee` from `./employee.model`.

The `IAuditService` interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/audit/audit.service.interface.ts` with method `record(record: Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditRecord>`, importing `AuditRecord` from `./audit.model`.

The `AuditRecord` entity interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts` with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `entityType: string`, `entityId: string`, `action: AuditAction`, `performedBy: string`, `changes: Record<string, unknown> | null`, `createdAt: Date`, importing `AuditAction` from `../../shared/types`.
All six files pass `tsc --noEmit` with the project's strict TypeScript configuration (strict: true, no implicit any, strict null checks) and produce zero type errors.

constraints: No barrel exports (index.ts) in the employee or audit modules — barrel exports are deferred to Phase 1 part 2.
No concrete implementations — this phase produces ONLY type definitions and interfaces. No classes, no database queries, no service logic.
No tests in this phase — tests are deferred to Phase 1 part 2.
The `no-any` constraint from HARNESS.json applies: `AuditRecord.changes` must use `Record<string, unknown>`, not `any`.

The three enums (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, AuditAction) must be TypeScript `enum` declarations, not string literal union types — the reconciled architecture explicitly calls them enumerations and the chief-architect-agent confirmed they should be runtime + type enums.
All imports must use relative paths matching the dependency map: employee → shared-types, audit → shared-types. No cross-imports between employee and audit modules.
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementations (EmployeeRepository, PgLeaveRequestRepository, etc.) — deferred to Phase 1 part 2 and later phases.
Concrete service implementations (EmployeeService, AuditService, etc.) — deferred to Phase 1 part 2 and later phases.
Barrel exports (index.ts) for employee and audit modules — deferred to Phase 1 part 2.
Leave policy, leave balance, and leave request modules — these are Phase 2, 3, and 4 respectively.
